name: Firebird - Tale of the Stolen Light
description:
About This Game

FIREBIRD – A Fairy-Tale Action-Adventure Platformer. Dark and Fun.

THE FIREBIRD HAS BEEN STOLEN.
THE WORLD IS DROWNING IN SHADOWS.
MOVE FAST — OR DISAPPEAR.

Firebird is a high-speed 2D Metroidvania where movement is your weapon.
Dash through deadly forests, outsmart mythic guardians, and reshape reality in haunting Dream Worlds.

Download the demo and play now.

Built in Unreal Engine 5, Firebird challenges players with tight traversal, creative puzzles, and stylish platforming-driven combat.

Agility and timing are everything. From wall jumps to monster vaults, every movement is a weapon—and every level introduces a new mechanic to master. Whether you’re dodging death traps or reshaping reality in dreamlike sub-levels, Firebird never stops evolving.

What Makes Firebird Special:

  • Movement IS Combat – No button-mashing. Every jump matters.

  • Dream Worlds Twist Reality – Light and shadow reshape entire levels.

  • Zero Filler – Every stage introduces a new mechanic.

  • Brutal Outside, Mind-Bending Inside – Fast platforming meets clever puzzles.

  • Built in Unreal Engine 5 – Fluid animations, deep atmosphere, no jank.

    FOR FANS OF:

    Hollow Knight
    Ori and the Blind Forest
    Celeste
    Dead Cells

    Planned for PC Q2 2026 and consoles in Q3 2026, Firebird blends the challenge of Hollow Knight with the magic of Ori and the Blind Forest, offering an unforgettable ride through a fading world—and a second chance to reignite its flame.
short_desc: A fast-paced 2D action-adventure platformer set in a dark fairy tale world. Master creative traversal, uncover secrets, and reshape reality through light and shadow as you battle mythic guardians in handcrafted, atmospheric levels.
